hook.name: LaunchHook
hook.description: Launchpad hook for meme token pools on Robinhood Chain. Captures all trading fees in WETH via swap deltas with a three-phase fee model: exponentially decaying 90%→3% during the guard phase (~5s), then flat 1% through curve and post-graduation. Enforces per-wallet and per-block buy caps during the first ~10s. Graduates the pool automatically when cumulative WETH raised crosses a configured threshold.
